description: GameNation.in (India) game, console and accessory search from the JSON API its website uses: product name, product ID, condition (new or pre-owned), selling price and MRP in INR, discount %, trade-in cash and trade-in store-credit offers, availability and image. Returns the total match count and up to 200 products. Unofficial endpoint, may change. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

available.description: true = only products in stock (default false = all)

q.description: Search words, e.g. fifa, spider-man, ps5 controller (required, 2-80 chars)
